description: chibi knight, silver armor with red tabard, small round red shield

down_idle.action: standing idle facing the viewer, feet planted, subtle breathing and one blink; this row is the front direction anchor

down_walk.action: walk cycle facing the viewer: left foot forward, mid stance, right foot forward; arms swing in opposition; feet stay on the ground line

side_idle.action: standing idle in pure side profile facing camera-right, feet planted, subtle breathing; this row is the side direction anchor

side_walk.action: walk cycle in pure side profile facing camera-right: front foot forward, mid stance, back foot forward; arms swing in opposition; feet stay on the ground line

up_idle.action: standing idle seen from behind, back of head and shoulders, no visible face, subtle breathing; this row is the back direction anchor

up_walk.action: walk cycle seen from behind: left foot forward, mid stance, right foot forward; arms swing in opposition; no visible face
